sentences.text: A large, ongoing surveillance project in Botswana tracked birth outcomes in public hospitals, covering more than two-thirds of the country's births, with every live-born infant and stillbirth undergoing a physical surface examination as part of routine care.
Between August 2014 and August 2022, the study evaluated 235,286 deliveries, including 11,110 involving dolutegravir exposure at conception and 24,368 involving other antiretroviral drugs.
Researchers compared the rates of neural tube defects and major structural abnormalities between these two groups, adjusting for maternal age.
The prevalence of neural tube defects was 0.11% in the dolutegravir group and 0.10% in the non-dolutegravir group, showing no significant difference.
Rates of major external structural abnormalities were also similar, at 0.75% for dolutegravir exposure and 0.76% for other antiretroviral drugs.
